chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.titan_storm: The storm broke. The shadow is still above the clouds.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch3_wait_: You're back. How was the wind?
I have always chased them. The whale, the shell. I thought if I chased long enough, I'd catch up.
But that bird isn't something you chase. It's something you wait for. Down at the peak I felt called by the wind, and your story told me why.
Only you will climb. I'll wait here by the fire. When you come back, tell me about the wind.

The wind blew backwards this morning. A storm is walking up against it, toward us.
The whale crossed the sky and the shell waited in the sea. The next one flies wearing a storm.

In the afternoon storm hour it settles on a high peak. Go to the foot of the peak and see how the wind moves.
I won't go. Only you need to climb.
Beside a charred cart lay a page, soaked and dried again.

"Who called the storm bird the shadow in the sky? I saw it. The shadow was higher, and far larger."

The handwriting is familiar. It looks a lot like my own.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_size.body:
While the shadow passed, the thunder wing crouched on a peak with its wings over its head. A bird the size of a mountain, afraid.

The shadow crossed above it, slowly, many times its size. That is what lives above the clouds.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_size.title: Shadow and Wing
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_wind_tablet:
Three tablets of the wind folk stood apart on the heights.

They called the shadow a god. The storm bird flies under the clouds. When they knew, it was too late.

The third tablet ends mid-sentence. The carver seems to have stopped.
message.skyabyss.ch3.aftermath: The storyteller said: "The sky cleared only for a moment. The one above the clouds is still there."
message.skyabyss.ch3.burn_line: A black streak runs across the far ground. Too long for a single bolt.
message.skyabyss.ch3.low_beasts: The beasts press low to the ground. Thunder, far off, at night. From upwind.
message.skyabyss.ch3.low_plain: Thunder rolled far away under a cloudless night. From upwind.
message.skyabyss.ch3.pack: A single page lies beside the charred pack.
message.skyabyss.ch3.ruin: One copper needle is left on the broken tower. Lightning will choose it.
message.skyabyss.ch3.showcase_1: The mountain-sized bird crouches on the peak. It covers its head with its wings.
message.skyabyss.ch3.showcase_2: A shadow crosses above it. The thunder wing looks small.
message.skyabyss.ch3.showcase_3: That is what lives above the clouds. Even the thunder wing cannot lift its head.
message.skyabyss.ch3.vane: The vane turns against the wind.
message.skyabyss.ch3.wing_flash: In one flash, the shape of a wing hung under the clouds. Did I imagine it?
Reach the foot of the perched titan in the storm hour

In the afternoon storm hour the giant bird settles on a peak.
I will go to the foot of the peak and watch how the wind moves.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_isana_wait.done: Isana will wait by the fire. Only I will climb.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_isana_wait.summar: Go to the foot of the peak in the afternoon storm hour, and tell Isana what you saw.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_isana_wait.tell.j:
The wind spiralled at the bird's feet.
I will go and tell Isana.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_isana_wait.tell.t: Tell Isana about the foot of the peak
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_isana_wait.title: At the Foot of the Peak
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_wind_marks.done: The wind folk called the shadow a god. Perhaps it was the bird they misread.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_wind_marks.summar: Follow the marks of the storm that runs against the wind.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sub_wind_marks.title: Marks of the Wind
Since morning the wind has blown the wrong way.
A vane is said to stand on the heights, and a broken tower, a charred pack and the wind folk's tablets lie nearby.
Find the pack burnt by lightning
Find the vane on the hill
